sentences.zh: 还有第二章，根据该章，可以因不平等获取而起诉政府办公室。

sentences.en: And Title II, under which government offices could be sued for unequal access.
sentences.zh: 不过很快，原告也开始提起第三章案件，即那些针对冰淇淋店、租车公司、电影院、酒店、

sentences.en: Soon, though, plaintiffs also began to file Title III cases, those related to physical barriers against ice cream parlors, rental car companies, movie theaters, hotels,
sentences.zh: 私立大学等实体物理障碍的案件。

sentences.en: private universities, and the like.
sentences.zh: 许多人赢了。

sentences.en: Many won.
sentences.zh: ADA 正在兑现其为残疾人开辟通道并减少歧视性做法的承诺。

sentences.en: The ADA was fulfilling its promise of opening access for, and reducing discriminatory practices against, the disabled.
sentences.zh: 由于担心根据 ADA 诉讼会提供经济激励，议员们在立法的起草上限制了原告获得金钱赔偿的能力。

sentences.en: Worried about offering a financial incentive to sue under the ADA, lawmakers wrote the law in a way that limits plaintiffs' ability to collect monetary damages.
sentences.zh: 一场成功的 ADA 诉讼通常以禁令救济告终，即法院强制纠正违规行为，且被告全额支付原告的法律费用。

sentences.en: A successful ADA suit generally ends in injunctive relief, a court's forcing the violation to be fixed, and the plaintiffs' legal fees being paid in full by the defendant.
sentences.zh: 如果原告因无障碍障碍而遭受身体伤害，有时可以获得赔偿，但这很少见。

sentences.en: A plaintiff can sometimes collect damages if he suffered bodily harm as a result of the access barriers, but this is rare.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，这些诉讼中过去有、现在也仍然有金钱可图。

sentences.en: Still, there was, and still is, money to be gained in these suits.
sentences.zh: 法律要求被告承担法律费用的事实可能会鼓励律师起诉，批评者甚至声称这会使案件拖延数月甚至数年。

sentences.en: The fact that the law requires defendants to cover legal fees can encourage lawyers to sue, and even, critics claim, to drag the cases on for months or years.
sentences.zh: 事实上，代奇起诉“高帽厨师”的75,000美元是对他的案件所需的法律和专家咨询费的估计。

sentences.en: In fact, the $75,000 for which Deitch was suing top hatters was an estimate of the legal and expert consultancy fees that would be required in his case.
sentences.zh: 这个金额是将案件送入联邦法院所需的最低诉求额。

sentences.en: That amount was the minimum demand needed to get the case into federal court.
sentences.zh: 即使被告同意立即解决问题，这些案件也可能需要数月的法律程序、

sentences.en: Even if a defendant agrees to fix the problems immediately, these cases can require months of legal procedure,
sentences.zh: 专家调查和调解会议，这会推高账单。

sentences.en: expert investigations, and mediation sessions, which ratchet up the bill.
sentences.zh: 虽然在20世纪90年代提起了许多第三章 ADA 案件，但在20世纪00年代诉讼增加，在2010年代更是大幅上升。

sentences.en: While a number of Title III ADA cases were filed in the 1990s, lawsuits increased in the 2000s and rose even more in the 2010s.
sentences.zh: 消息已经传开，提起第三章 ADA 诉讼可以帮助残疾人加速期待已久的无障碍设施改善。

sentences.en: Word had gotten around that filing Title III ADA cases could help people with disabilities accelerate long-overdue improvements in access.
sentences.zh: 还有一个重要因素。

sentences.en: There was another big factor, too.
sentences.zh: 许多州将自己的 ADA 版本成文法化，其中一些法律（包括加利福尼亚州、佛罗里达州、宾夕法尼亚州、伊利诺伊州和纽约州）

sentences.en: Many states had codified their own versions of the ADA, and some of those laws, including in California, Florida, Pennsylvania, Illinois, and New York,
sentences.zh: 确实允许经济赔偿。

sentences.en: did allow for financial damages.
sentences.zh: 这意味着同时援引 ADA 和其中一项州法的诉讼可以为原告带来金钱赔偿。

sentences.en: That meant a lawsuit invoking both the ADA and one of these state laws could result in money for a plaintiff.
sentences.zh: 2012年，原告在联邦法院提起了2,495起第三章案件。

sentences.en: In 2012, plaintiffs filed 2,495 Title III cases in federal court.
sentences.zh: 到2017年，这一数字增加了一倍多，达到7,663起，

sentences.en: By 2017, that had more than tripled to 7,663 cases,
sentences.zh: 其中半数以上是在加利福尼亚州或佛罗里达州提起的，这两个州的州法对 ADA 原告特别有利。

sentences.en: more than half of which were filed in California or Florida, whose state laws can be particularly beneficial to ADA plaintiffs.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州是 ADA 诉讼特别热门的地点，因为其单独的州法被称为 UNRWA 民权法，

sentences.en: California is an especially popular place for ADA lawsuits because its separate state law, called the UNRWA Civil Rights Act,
sentences.zh: 允许在原告每次遇到无障碍障碍时索赔高达4,000美元的赔偿金，这意味着原告可以多次访问某家店面，

sentences.en: allows for damages of up to $4,000 each time a plaintiff encounters an accessibility barrier, meaning that a plaintiff can visit an establishment several times,
sentences.zh: 遇到相同的障碍，并为每次访问提出索赔。

sentences.en: encounter the same barrier, and state a claim for each visit.
sentences.zh: 加州的大多数残疾相关案件（包括代奇对“高帽厨师”提起的诉讼）都在联邦法院的一起捆绑诉讼中，

sentences.en: Most disability-related cases in California, including the one Deitch filed against top-hatters, cite violations under both the ADA and the state's UNRWA Act
sentences.zh: 同时引用了 ADA 和该州的 UNRWA 法案的违规行为。

sentences.en: in a single, bundled lawsuit in federal court.
sentences.zh: 当然，大多数案件都会达成和解，被告通常同意修复诉讼浮出水面的违规行为，并退还原告的法律费用，

sentences.en: Of course, most cases settle, with a defendant typically agreeing to fix the violations that the lawsuit surfaced, and pay back the plaintiff's legal fees,
sentences.zh: 通常为数千美元。

sentences.en: generally in the thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 在允许根据其残疾法律进行赔偿的州，原告也可以通过该过程获得经济补偿。

sentences.en: In states that allow damages under their disability laws, a plaintiff can also be financially compensated through that process.
sentences.zh: 在允许根据其残疾法律进行赔偿的州，原告也可以通过该过程获得经济补偿。

sentences.en: A paraplegic man named Samuel Love is known throughout California for filing hundreds of claims, mostly about non-compliant parking at businesses such as gas stations and hotels,
sentences.zh: 一名叫塞缪尔·洛夫的截瘫男子在整个加利福尼亚州因提起数百起诉讼而闻名，这些诉讼大多关于加油站和酒店等企业的无障碍停车位不合规问题，

sentences.en: violations he is able to find without even leaving his car.
sentences.zh: 这些违规情况他甚至不用下车就能发现。

sentences.en: In March 2020,
Love sued a San Jose store owner named Dong Nguyen in federal court in the Northern District of California, claiming that he failed to provide wheelchair-accessible sales counters.
sentences.zh: 洛夫在加利福尼亚州北区联邦法院起诉了一名名叫董阮的圣何塞店主，称其未能提供轮椅可及的销售柜台。

sentences.en: A judge dismissed the lawsuit after Love missed a deadline for filing paperwork.
sentences.zh: 由于洛夫错过了一项文件的提交截止日期，法官驳回了这起诉讼。

sentences.en: They are not customers,
sentences.zh: “他们根本不是顾客，”

sentences.en: Nguyen told me of serial litigants like Love.
sentences.zh: 阮在谈到像洛夫这样的连环原告时告诉我。

sentences.en: They go around looking for something and sue.
sentences.zh: “他们四处寻找问题然后提起诉讼。”

sentences.en: Love's ADA lawyer, Dennis Price, noted that his clients very frequently patronize the businesses they sue and are customers by any reasonable metric.
sentences.zh: 洛夫的《美国残疾人法案》（ADA）律师丹尼斯·普莱斯指出，他的客户非常经常光顾他们起诉的企业，按任何合理的标准来看他们都是顾客。

sentences.en: Price works at the Center for Disability Access, a prolific source of ADA suits.
sentences.zh: 普莱斯在残疾人无障碍通道中心工作，这是一个高产的ADA诉讼来源地。

sentences.en: Though its name might suggest a non-profit operation, the Center for Disability Access is in fact a wing of a private law firm called Potter Handy.
sentences.zh: 尽管这个名字听起来像是一个非营利机构，但残疾人无障碍通道中心实际上是Potter Handy这家私人律所的一个分支。

sentences.en: The firm files thousands of cases each year, many with repeat plaintiffs, including Love.
sentences.zh: 该律所每年提起数千起案件，其中许多案件的原告是重复的，包括洛夫。

sentences.en: Another client of Price's, a lawyer named Scott Johnson, who is quadriplegic, is perhaps the most infamous of serial litigants.
sentences.zh: 普莱斯的另一个客户、四肢瘫痪的律师斯科特·约翰逊，也许是其中最臭名昭著的连环原告。

sentences.en: This is partly because of the volume of his cases.
sentences.zh: 这部分是因为他的案件数量庞大。

sentences.en: On occasion, he has filed more than a dozen lawsuits in a single day.
sentences.zh: 他有时会在一天内提起十多起诉讼。

sentences.en: And partly because he has himself encountered legal trouble, including a federal indictment for failing to pay taxes
sentences.zh: 部分原因是他自己也遇到了法律麻烦，包括因未能就其近年来从ADA和解中获得的数十万美元

sentences.en: on hundreds of thousands of dollars he has earned in recent years from ADA settlements.
sentences.zh: 收入纳税而面临联邦起诉。

sentences.en: Johnson pleaded not guilty.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊坚决不认罪。

sentences.en: His lawyer in that case, Malcolm Siegel, contends that Johnson's settlement money was tax-exempt, and the case is awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 他在该案中的律师马尔科姆·西格尔坚称，约翰逊的和解金是免税的，目前该案正等待审判。

sentences.en: Johnson's former paralegals have said that he used to instruct them to drive around town looking for violations so Johnson could file suit.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊的前律师助理曾表示，他过去常常指示他们开车四处寻找违规行为，以便约翰逊能够提起诉讼。

sentences.en: At times, paralegals said, he would accompany them, but rarely leave the car.
sentences.zh: 律师助理说，有时他会陪同他们前往，但很少下车。

sentences.en: Price said Johnson was always present when potential violations were identified.
sentences.zh: 普莱斯表示，在发现潜在违规行为时，约翰逊总是会在现场。

sentences.en: In any given year,
sentences.zh: 在任何特定年份里，

sentences.en: Johnson files 300 to 400 lawsuits in California.
sentences.zh: 约翰逊都会在加州提起300到400起诉讼。

sentences.en: He has filed thousands over the course of his career.
sentences.zh: 在他的职业生涯中，他已经提起了数千起诉讼。

sentences.en: A handful of businesses closed for good following lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 少数企业在诉讼后彻底倒闭了。

sentences.en: A hamburger joint, a deli, a beloved pool hall.
sentences.zh: 一家汉堡店、一家熟食店、一家备受喜爱的台球厅。

sentences.en: As for Scott Johnson,
sentences.zh: 至于斯科特·约翰逊，

sentences.en: he got nothing from me but a closed business.
sentences.zh: 他从我这里得到的只有一家倒闭的店。

sentences.en: Mike Murphy, the owner of the shuttered jointed Q pool hall, told me, the heartbreaking part of this is that it's a staple in the community.
sentences.zh: 倒闭的Q台球厅老板迈克·墨菲告诉我，最让人心碎的是，它是社区里的一大支柱。

sentences.en: It's a historic place.
sentences.zh: 这是一个具有历史意义的地方。

sentences.en: And that's gone because of this lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 而这一切都因为这场诉讼而消失了。

sentences.en: Price noted that a business's closure after a lawsuit does not imply causation.
sentences.zh: 普莱斯指出，诉讼后企业倒闭并不意味着存在因果关系。

sentences.en: He said that he and his colleagues see their clients as helping to enforce an important law.
sentences.zh: 他说，他和同事们认为他们的客户是在协助执行一项重要的法律。

sentences.en: These are testers,
sentences.zh: “这些都是测试员，”

sentences.en: Price told me.
sentences.zh: 普莱斯对我说。

sentences.en: They are making sure that California is compliant.
sentences.zh: “他们是在确保加州符合规定。”

sentences.en: They are putting themselves and their time on the line for access.
sentences.zh: “他们为了无障碍通行而押上了自己和他们的时间。”

sentences.en: In 2007, in response to a lawsuit claiming vexatious disability litigation, the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit issued an opinion making a similar point.
sentences.zh: 2007年，针对一起指控恶意残疾人诉讼的诉讼，美国联邦第九巡回上诉法院发布了一项意见，表达了类似观点。

sentences.en: For the ADA to yield its promise of equal access for the disabled, it may indeed be necessary and desirable for committed individuals to bring serial litigation
sentences.zh: 为了让《美国残疾人法案》兑现其为残疾人提供平等无障碍环境的承诺，坚定的人士提起连环诉讼可能确实是必要且可取的，

sentences.en: advancing the time when public accommodations will be compliant with the ADA.
sentences.zh: 这能推动公共场所提前符合《美国残疾人法案》的规定。

sentences.en: Once Deitch sued Top Hatters,
sentences.zh: 自从戴奇起诉Top Hatters以来，

sentences.en: Vu thought it might be over for the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 武（Vu）曾认为这家餐馆可能要完蛋了。

sentences.en: But she rallied, taking out a loan with a double-digit interest rate, while also borrowing from relatives to keep the business afloat and pay a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 但她振作了起来，贷款利率高达两位数，同时向亲戚借钱，以维持餐厅运营并支付律师费。

sentences.en: She did some research on Deitch and learned that he was a serial filer.
sentences.zh: 她对戴奇做了一些调查，得知他是一名连环起诉者。

sentences.en: He did this for a living, she concluded.
sentences.zh: 她得出结论，他以此为生。

sentences.en: She was committed to her restaurants being accessible to all guests, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说，她致力于让自己的餐厅对所有客人都无障碍。

sentences.en: But to her eye, Deitch's lawsuit was a ploy for cash.
sentences.zh: 但在她看来，戴奇的诉讼就是一个套取现金的计谋。

sentences.en: The timing, during a catastrophic pandemic, didn't help.
sentences.zh: 正值大流行这一灾难时期，这个时机毫无帮助。

sentences.en: On some nights, Vu had only six orders, but she needed roughly 50 to break even.
sentences.zh: 有时在晚上，武只有六个订单，但她大约需要50个订单才能收支平衡。

sentences.en: We basically kept it open and running so that our workers would have a job, she told me.
sentences.zh: “我们基本上就是让它开门营业，好让我们的工人们有一份工作，”她对我说。

sentences.en: In spite of the generosity she felt from a band of customers who stayed loyal to the restaurant, one even donated $200 from his stimulus check to Top Hatters,
sentences.zh: 尽管她感受到了来自一群对餐厅忠诚不渝的顾客的慷慨——甚至有一位从他的经济刺激支票中捐出了200美元给Top Hatters——

sentences.en: she was sinking deeper into debt and growing misanthropic.
sentences.zh: 但她还是越陷越深于债务之中，并变得有点厌世。

sentences.en: For a while there, she told me, I just looked at everyone like, you're going to sue me, you're out to get me, you know?
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，有一段时间，我看着每个人都觉得：你们要起诉我，你们是来整我的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: In many accessibility lawsuits,
sentences.zh: 在许多无障碍诉讼中，

sentences.en: ADA inspectors are hired to take a look at properties and see where they fall short.
sentences.zh: 人们会聘请ADA检查员来检查房产，看看有哪些地方不达标。

sentences.en: According to Candace Liu, an inspector who visited Top Hatters, the counter that Deitch had complained about was, in fact, compliant.
sentences.zh: 据参观过Top Hatters的检查员坎迪斯·刘称，戴奇抱怨的那个柜台实际上是合规的。

sentences.en: Liu recommended a few other changes, however, to ensure accessibility.
sentences.zh: 不过，刘建议做一些其他改动，以确保无障碍通行。

sentences.en: Moving a chair and cabinet from the bathroom, using stickers to indicate which tables were accessible,
sentences.zh: 移走浴室里的椅子和橱柜，用贴纸标明哪些桌子是无障碍的，

sentences.en: installing a locking mechanism to keep the gate from accidentally closing during business hours.
sentences.zh: 安装一个锁定装置，防止大门在营业时间内意外关闭。

sentences.en: Deitch said, I don't believe the list of recommended changes adequately represents the situation, but confidentiality constrains me from providing a fuller account.
sentences.zh: 戴奇说：“我认为修改建议清单并未充分反映实际情况，但保密规定限制我提供更全面的说明。”

sentences.en: To an extent,
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，

sentences.en: Vu felt vindicated.
sentences.zh: 武感到自己得到了平反。

sentences.en: But my lawyer said it's cheaper and faster to just settle and do what they say than fight it, she told me.
sentences.zh: 但她告诉我：“我的律师说，与其抗争，不如直接庭外和解并照他们说的做，这样更省钱也更快。”

sentences.en: In September 2020, the parties settled.
sentences.zh: 2020年9月，双方达成和解。

sentences.en: Top Hatters would pay a certain sum and fix the issues that the inspector had found.
sentences.zh: Top Hatters将支付一定金额并修复检查员发现的问题。

sentences.en: The terms of the settlement prevent both parties from disclosing the amount.
sentences.zh: 和解条款禁止双方透露具体金额。

sentences.en: It was less than the initial 75,000 Deitch demanded, but large enough that Vu recalls thinking, well, there goes our tuition money.
sentences.zh: 这比戴奇最初要求的75000美元要少，但数额足够大，以至于武回想起当时的想法时觉得：好吧，我们的学费没了。

sentences.en: Her son was heading to college.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子正准备上大学。

sentences.en: Afterward, she alerted every small business owner she knew to hire a consultant to be sure of compliance.
sentences.zh: 此后，她提醒她认识的每一个小企业主去聘请咨询师，以确保合规。

sentences.en: I was like a walking PSA, she told me.
sentences.zh: 她对我说：“我当时就像一个行走的公益广告。”

sentences.en: Everywhere I went, I said, do you know about this?
sentences.zh: “无论走到哪里我都说，你知道这个事吗？”

sentences.en: You have to be careful or this could happen to you.
sentences.zh: “你必须小心，否则这可能会发生在你身上。”

sentences.en: She wanted to make sure that everyone had fully accessible, non-discriminatory businesses, and that they fixed any barriers before they were served with papers.
sentences.zh: 她想确保每个人都拥有完全无障碍且无歧视的企业，并且在收到传票之前就修好任何障碍。

sentences.en: I wanted to meet Albert Theitch to hear his side of things, so I wrote him a note.
sentences.zh: 我想见见阿尔伯特·戴奇以听取他这一边的说法，所以我给他写了一张便条。

sentences.en: He expressed some hesitation.
sentences.zh: 他表现出了一些犹豫。

sentences.en: Most media coverage has been slanted against plaintiffs like me.
sentences.zh: 大多数媒体报道都对像我这样的原告带有偏见。

sentences.en: He sent me a link to a website he recently created.
sentences.zh: 他给我发了他最近创建的一个网站的链接。

sentences.en: The civil rights of those with disabilities are violated every time they're denied the same benefits and privileges as the able-bodied.
sentences.zh: 每当残疾人被剥夺与健全人相同的福利和特权时，他们的民权就受到了侵犯。

sentences.en: The homepage reads,
sentences.zh: 主页上写道：

sentences.en: Yet relatively few have the time, energy, courage, and fortitude to insist that these rights are honored and protected in accordance with the law.
sentences.zh: 然而相对较少有人拥有时间、精力、勇气和毅力去坚持根据法律尊崇和保护这些权利。

sentences.en: I invite you to view the situation from the vantage point of someone in a wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 我邀请您从坐轮椅者的角度来看待这个情况。

sentences.en: To the extent that serial litigation over the ADA has received attention, mostly in local papers and on television,
sentences.zh: 在关于ADA的连环诉讼受到关注的范围内（主要在当地报纸和电视上），

sentences.en: it's common for litigants like Theitch to be cast as enemies of the small business.
sentences.zh: 像戴奇这样的原告通常被塑造为小企业的敌人。

sentences.en: In a 2020 Law Review article, the lawyer Evelyn Clark wrote,
sentences.zh: 在2020年的一篇《法律评论》文章中，律师伊芙琳·克拉克写道：

sentences.en: Clark, who is disabled, points to a segment of a 2010 episode of This American Life entitled
sentences.zh: 身有残疾的克拉克指出，2010年有一集名为《This American Life》的节目片段，

sentences.en: Cry Babies, a rare instance of ADA lawsuits receiving national attention, in which a reporter follows a serial ADA litigant around in an attempt to call him on his bluff.
sentences.zh: 题为《爱哭鬼》，这是ADA诉讼获得全国关注的罕见例子，其中一名记者跟随一名ADA连环原告，试图当面戳穿他的虚张声势。

sentences.en: In California, a kind of crybaby cottage industry has popped up around, of all things, the Americans with Disabilities Act.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，围绕着《美国残疾人法案》，竟然冒出了一种爱哭鬼家庭手工业。

sentences.en: Ira Glass, the host of the show, said, To Clark's eye, this kind of coverage distorts the main issue,
sentences.zh: 该节目的主持人艾拉·格拉斯说：“在克拉克看来，这种报道歪曲了核心问题，”

sentences.en: which is that people with disabilities continue to face significant barriers in getting through their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 即残疾人在日常生活中仍然面临着巨大的无障碍障碍。

sentences.en: She told me that the existing media coverage has been so bad, and, to be fair, the lawsuits so copious, that people see a person in a wheelchair come into their restaurant
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，现有的媒体报道太糟糕了，而且公平地说，诉讼又如此之多，以至于人们看到一个坐轮椅的人走进他们的餐馆

sentences.en: and think they're going to get sued.
sentences.zh: 就会觉得他们要被起诉了。

sentences.zh: 金·E·

sentences.zh: 尼尔森在

sentences.en: A Disability History of the United States, rub up against the American value of individualistic, self-sufficient grit.
sentences.zh: 《美国残疾史》一书中写道，残疾与美国人崇尚的个人主义、自力更生的韧性格格不入。

sentences.en: People with disabilities are thus often cast as a drain.
sentences.zh: 因此，残疾人经常被视为一种负担。

sentences.en: Serial litigants like Deitch are read as scammers trying to turn a profit.
sentences.zh: 像戴奇这样的连环原告被解读为试图牟利的骗子。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费探索《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你就可以。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall, to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Eventually, Deitch agreed to meet in his backyard in the hope of offering a different perspective.
sentences.zh: 最终，戴奇同意在后院见面，希望能提供一个不同的视角。

sentences.en: He lives with his wife, Andrea, in a sweet one-story cottage in a tree-lined residential neighborhood of Oakland.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子安德烈住在奥克兰一条绿树成荫的住宅区内一栋温馨的单层平房里。

sentences.en: They had left the front door open for my arrival, and when I walked in,
sentences.zh: 为了迎接我的到来，他们把前门开着，当我走进去时，

sentences.en: Andrea was readying Deitch to head outside into the chilly spring afternoon, helping him pull his jacket over his arms and draping a blanket across his legs.
sentences.zh: 安德烈正准备让戴奇出门去迎接寒冷的春日午后，帮他把夹克套上胳膊，并在他腿上盖了一条毯子。

sentences.en: Deitch wore wire-rimmed glasses and a baseball cap over a thinning head of hair.
sentences.zh: 戴奇戴着一副金属边眼镜，稀疏的头发上戴着一顶棒球帽。

sentences.en: He greeted me warmly and invited me to follow him outside.
sentences.zh: 他热情地迎接了我，并邀请我跟着他到外面去。

sentences.en: Under the shade of his backyard pine, Deitch told me that in 2008, he attended a muscular dystrophy support group,
sentences.zh: 在后院松树的树荫下，戴奇告诉我，2008年他参加了一个肌营养不良症互助小组，

sentences.en: where an ADA plaintiff's lawyer named Tom Stewart made a presentation about disability rights.
sentences.zh: 在那里，一位名叫汤姆·斯图尔特的ADA原告律师就残疾人权利做了演讲。

sentences.en: Stewart also talked about the possibility of seeking legal relief, and Deitch signed up to speak with him.
sentences.zh: 斯图尔特还谈到了寻求法律救济的可能性，戴奇便报名与他交谈。

sentences.en: In 2009, he filed his first case.
sentences.zh: 2009年，他提起了他的第一起案件。

sentences.en: It set in motion what has become almost a second career for Deitch, one that, like most jobs, requires time, comes with a fair dose of stress, and offers financial compensation.
sentences.zh: 这拉开了戴奇几乎可以说是第二职业的序幕，这份工作和大多数工作一样，需要时间，伴随着相当多的压力，并提供金钱报酬。

sentences.en: Deitch later started working with more.
sentences.zh: 戴奇后来开始与更多人合作。

sentences.en: While exact amounts are confidential,
sentences.zh: 虽然具体金额是保密的，

sentences.en: Deitch told me that in any case that settles, his share has typically been $4,000 or less, and in some cases, he has ended up with no financial compensation at all.
sentences.zh: 但戴奇告诉我，在任何达成和解的案件中，他的份额通常在4000美元或以下，在某些情况下，他最终根本没有得到任何经济补偿。

sentences.en: Early on, he began to feel that filing these cases helped him find the agency he had lost as his illness progressed.
sentences.zh: 早期，他开始觉得提起这些诉讼帮助他找到了随着病情加重而失去的自主权。

sentences.en: The more limited his mobility became, the more of the world had become closed to him.
sentences.zh: 他的行动能力越受限，他对世界的参与就越被关闭。

sentences.en: Restaurants and shops he once frequented and enjoyed were no longer places he could go with ease or at all.
sentences.zh: 他曾经经常光顾并喜爱的餐馆和商店不再是他能够轻松前往甚至无法前往的地方。

sentences.en: He felt he was fighting not just against the difficulties, barriers, and humiliations he routinely faces as a disabled person trying to go about his life,
sentences.zh: 他觉得他不仅是在与他作为一个试图过上正常生活的残疾人日常面临的困难、障碍和羞辱作斗争，

sentences.en: but on behalf of a larger community.
sentences.zh: 也是在为一个更大的群体代言。

sentences.en: The work wasn't easy, though, and his adversarial nature could feel painful.
sentences.zh: 不过，这项工作并不容易，他的好斗天性可能会带来痛苦。

sentences.en: It's like being a parking meter person, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“这就像当个抄表员一样。”

sentences.en: They don't thank you.
sentences.zh: “他们不会感谢你的。”

sentences.en: From his perspective, it's not his lawyer who is drawing out the cases, but rather the businesses.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，拖延案件的不是他的律师，而是企业本身。

sentences.en: If businesses truly wanted to be accessible, they would fix the barriers and settle cases as soon as possible, keeping costs lower for everyone.
sentences.zh: 如果企业真的想做到无障碍，他们就会修复障碍并尽快达成和解，从而为所有人降低成本。

sentences.en: Though even this strategy can cost defendants tens of thousands of dollars in settlement and legal fees, as it had for top hatters,
sentences.zh: 尽管即使采取这种战略，也可能让被告在和解金和律师费上花掉数万美元，就像Top Hatters那样，

sentences.en: and more if there is significant remediation needed to fix accessibility barriers,
sentences.zh: 如果需要进行大量的整改来修复无障碍障碍，费用还会更高，

sentences.en: Deitch's complaint against top hatters explained that he and his wife had gone there to celebrate his birthday.
sentences.zh: 戴奇针对Top Hatters的起诉书解释说，他和妻子去那里是为了庆祝他的生日。

sentences.en: He had made the reservation with a specific accessibility request, and it simply wasn't met.
sentences.zh: 他提出了具体的无障碍要求进行了预约，而这一要求根本没有得到满足。

sentences.en: It was frustrating and demoralizing,
sentences.zh: 戴奇向我解释说，

sentences.en: Deitch explained to me, to have to ask for special help to get inside.
sentences.zh: 必须请求特殊帮助才能进去，这令人沮丧且感到士气低落。

sentences.en: When I asked if he could recall any other details about the evening, he said he couldn't.
sentences.zh: 当我问他是否还记得当晚的其他细节时，他说他不记得了。

sentences.en: I also asked Deitch about another restaurant he had recently sued.
sentences.zh: 我还问了戴奇关于他最近起诉的另一家餐馆的情况。

sentences.en: I think there was an issue with the bathroom, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我想洗手间有问题。”

sentences.en: He stared at the table for a moment, trying to remember.
sentences.zh: 他盯着桌子看了一会儿，试图回忆起来。

sentences.en: And there was a problem with the seating.
sentences.zh: “座位也有问题。”

sentences.en: In a Google search, I was served an ad by an ADA defense lawyer named Rick Morin.
sentences.zh: 在谷歌搜索中，我看到了一则由一位名叫里克·莫林的ADA辩护律师投放的广告。

sentences.en: Albert Deitch lawsuit, the ad read.
sentences.zh: 广告上写着：“阿尔伯特·戴奇诉讼案。”

sentences.en: We provide strong and effective representation to help you take a stand.
sentences.zh: “我们提供强有力且有效的代理服务，助您立场坚定。”

sentences.en: Call now.
sentences.zh: “立即致电。”

sentences.en: Deitch is a marriage and family therapist, and if potential clients search for his name and see Morin's ad, it could impact his business.
sentences.zh: 戴奇是一名婚姻和家庭治疗师，如果潜在客户搜索他的名字并看到莫林的广告，这可能会影响他的生意。

sentences.en: Morin, in Deitch's eye, is using his name to profit from ADA lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 在戴奇看来，莫林是在利用他的名字从ADA诉讼中牟利。

sentences.en: Morin wrote in an email,
sentences.zh: 莫林在一封电子邮件中写道：

sentences.en: These mom-and-pop businesses cannot defend themselves on their own.
sentences.zh: 这些夫妻老婆店自己无法进行辩护。

sentences.en: Deitch told me he created his own website to have somewhere to send people inquiring about the lawsuits and to create a platform for his perspective.
sentences.zh: 戴奇告诉我，他创建自己的网站是为了有一个地方可以指引那些询问诉讼的人，并为他的观点建立一个平台。

sentences.en: I asked Deitch why, if accessibility is the purpose, he brings lawsuits instead of just writing a letter to a business asking for a fix.
sentences.zh: 我问戴奇，如果无障碍是目的，他为什么不直接给企业写信要求整改，而是要提起诉讼。

sentences.en: The simple answer, he said, is that asking doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 简单的回答是，他说，请求是没有用的。

sentences.en: He has tried again and again, only to go back to a business and see the same barriers in place.
sentences.zh: 他一次又一次地尝试，结果却总是回到某家店，看到同样的障碍依然存在。

sentences.en: The fact is, the ADA functions because it presents a legal threat.
sentences.zh: 事实是，《美国残疾人法案》之所以能发挥作用，是因为它构成了法律威胁。

sentences.en: Most businesses will pay thousands of dollars to fix their bathrooms or install wheelchair ramps, not because it's the right thing to do, but because they could be sued
sentences.zh: 大多数企业愿意花数千美元来修理浴室或安装无障碍斜坡，不是因为这样做是正确的，而是因为他们可能会被起诉，

sentences.en: for many thousands of dollars more for not having done it.
sentences.zh: 因为没有这样做而面临更多数千美元的罚款。

sentences.en: This is a law that exists in the heavens,
sentences.zh: 这是一个存在于天堂的法律，

sentences.en: Davis, the scholar of disability studies, told me.
sentences.zh: 残疾研究学者戴维斯对我说。

sentences.en: It doesn't work unless you bring a lawsuit.
sentences.zh: 除非你提起诉讼，否则它就起不了作用。

sentences.en: At the same time,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Deitch told me plainly, if there weren't some money involved, I probably wouldn't do it.
sentences.zh: 代奇直言不讳地对我说，如果其中没有涉及一些金钱，我可能不会这么做。

sentences.en: It takes a good deal of its time to bring such suits, not to mention the stress and public exposure of the work.
sentences.zh: 提起这类诉讼需要花费大量时间，更不用说工作带来的压力和公众曝光了。

sentences.en: Right before we went outside,
sentences.zh: 就在我们走到外面之前，

sentences.en: Deitch asked his wife to grab a piece of paper he had left on the printer.
sentences.zh: 代奇让他的妻子拿一张他留在打印机上的纸。

sentences.en: Now he took it from his coat pocket and slid it across the table to me.
sentences.zh: 现在他把纸从大衣口袋里拿出来，顺着桌子滑给我。

sentences.en: Disability Out-of-Pocket Expenses, the typewritten document was titled.
sentences.zh: 这份打印文件的标题是“残疾人零星自付费用”。

sentences.en: He had listed estimated costs for a disabled person's basic needs.
sentences.zh: 他列出了残疾人基本需求的估计费用。

sentences.en: One-time expenses included
sentences.zh: 一次性费用包括

sentences.en: $10,000 for an overhead lift system and $4,000 for an adjustable bed.
sentences.zh: 1万美元的头顶升降系统和4000万美元的可调节床。

sentences.en: A wheelchair-accessible ban set him back $65,000.
sentences.zh: 一张无障碍长椅让他花掉了6.5万美元。

sentences.en: Deitch is on his second.
sentences.zh: 代奇正在用他的第二张。

sentences.en: And a power wheelchair cost $25,000.
sentences.zh: 电动轮椅花了2.5万美元。

sentences.en: He's on his third.
sentences.zh: 他正在用他的第三辆。

sentences.en: Only $10,000 of this was covered by insurance.
sentences.zh: 其中只有1万美元由保险支付。

sentences.en: Then there are the annual costs.
sentences.zh: 然后是年度费用。

sentences.en: As Deitch's mobility worsened, it became more difficult for his wife to provide adequate care, which put a strain on their relationship.
sentences.zh: 随着代奇行动能力的恶化，他的妻子越来越难提供足够的照顾，这给他们的关系带来了压力。

sentences.en: I want to be your wife, not your caretaker, she told him.
sentences.zh: 我想做你的妻子，而不是你的看护人，她对他说。

sentences.en: This was hard to hear, but he knew she was right, so they hired outside help.
sentences.zh: 这话很难接受，但他知道她是正确的，于是他们雇用了外部帮助。

sentences.en: Now, they spend $55,000 for a daytime caregiver.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们花费5.5万美元请日间护理员。

sentences.en: He expects to have to hire a nighttime caregiver soon as well, because he has been needing to get up more often at night.
sentences.zh: 他预计很快也得雇一个夜间护理员，因为他晚上起夜的次数越来越频繁。

sentences.en: That could cost another $45,000.
sentences.zh: 那可能还要花费4.5万美元。

sentences.en: Living in this world as a disabled person is costly, emotionally, physically, and financially.
sentences.zh: 作为一个残疾人生活在这个世界上代价高昂，在情感、身体和经济上都是如此。

sentences.en: The law is subsidizing me to correct things, he told me.
sentences.zh: 法律在补贴我纠正问题，他告诉我。

sentences.en: Then I earn money to defray the exorbitant costs of being disabled.
sentences.zh: 然后我赚钱来抵消残疾带来的高昂费用。

sentences.en: Viewed this way, the United States government is not only outsourcing the enforcement of its law to individuals like Deitch, it is also outsourcing the cost of social supports
sentences.zh: 这样看来，美国政府不仅将法律的执行外包给了像代奇这样的个人，还将社会支持的成本外包给了企业。

sentences.en: for the disabled to businesses.
sentences.zh: 残疾人的企业。

sentences.en: The Americans with Disabilities Act wasn't set up to defray the cost of being disabled, though, but to simply ensure access.
sentences.zh: 然而，《美国残疾人法案》的设立并不是为了抵消残疾的成本，而只是为了确保无障碍通行。

sentences.en: Before I left,
sentences.zh: 在我离开之前，

sentences.en: Deitch led me inside and gave me a tour of his house.
sentences.zh: 代奇带我进屋，参观了他的房子。

sentences.en: In his bedroom, a metal crossbeam was bolted into the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 在他的卧室里，天花板上用螺栓固定着一根金属横梁。

sentences.en: A hook fastened to the beam could slide from side to side.
sentences.zh: 固定在横梁上的挂钩可以左右滑动。

sentences.en: This was part of the overhead lift system mentioned on the paper he showed me.
sentences.zh: 这是他向我展示的文件中提到的头顶升降系统的一部分。

sentences.en: I sit in this harness here, he explained, picking up a set of cloth straps from where they lay on the mattress.
sentences.zh: 我坐在这个吊具里，他解释道，从床垫上拿出一套布带。

sentences.en: And then this hook attaches to it and helps lift me in and out of bed.
sentences.zh: 然后这个挂钩扣在上面，帮我吊进吊出床铺。

sentences.en: They had installed these beams in the bathroom, too, so he could be lifted onto the toilet and into the shower.
sentences.zh: 他们也在浴室里安装了这些横梁，这样他就可以被吊到马桶和淋浴间里。

sentences.en: The fixtures have made a huge positive impact on his mobility and on his wife and caretaker.
sentences.zh: 这些设施对他的行动能力以及他的妻子和看护人产生了巨大的积极影响。

sentences.en: But they weren't cheap.
sentences.zh: 但它们并不便宜。

sentences.en: Deitch told me the pandemic has made him a little hesitant to sue, as he knows businesses are struggling.
sentences.zh: 代奇告诉我，大流行让他在起诉时有些犹豫，因为他知道企业正在挣扎。

sentences.en: While he filed several cases, like the one against top hatters, for visits he made before government ordered shutdowns started in March 2020, he hasn't filed any based on visits
sentences.zh: 虽然他针对2020年3月政府下令停工前访问的场所提起了一些诉讼，比如针对高顶帽店的诉讼，但他没有根据访问提起任何诉讼

sentences.en: he made after that time.
sentences.zh: 那之后他做的。

sentences.en: His slowest pace since his first lawsuit in 2009.
sentences.zh: 这是他自2009年第一起诉讼以来最慢的步伐。

sentences.en: I have to wrestle with my conscience and my wife, he said.
sentences.zh: 我必须与我的良心和我的妻子作斗争，他说。

sentences.en: Andrea, he explained, has grown more hesitant about lawsuits.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，安德烈对诉讼越来越犹豫了。

sentences.en: She is a compassionate and sympathetic person by nature, and is conflicted about them.
sentences.zh: 她天生是一个富有同情心和同理心的人，对这些事情感到矛盾。

sentences.en: I wish that the burden of enforcement did not fall on the disabled themselves,
sentences.zh: 我希望执行的负担不会落在残疾人自己身上，

sentences.en: Andrea wrote to me later.
sentences.zh: 安德烈后来写信给我。

sentences.en: Yet the help
sentences.zh: 然而，帮助

sentences.en: Albert has gotten through settlements has made it possible for us to afford some of the care he needs.
sentences.zh: 阿尔伯特通过和解获得的资金使我们能够负担他所需的一些护理费用。

sentences.en: Deitch doesn't want businesses to suffer, but he also wants to fight for proper access.
sentences.zh: 代奇不希望企业受苦，但他也想为争取适当的无障碍通行而战。

sentences.en: The question he now has to ask himself, he told me, is, what is the right thing to do under these circumstances that causes the greatest good?
